description.text: An expansion of the Scarlet & Violet series, released on 26 April 2024 in packs of five cards. Its headline is Ogerpon, the legendary Pokémon of the games' The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero: it comes as a Pokémon ex in each of its four masks, each a different type, with an Item that swaps an Ogerpon ex in play for one in the discard pile. The Kitakami siblings Carmine and Kieran are Supporters, and a group of Pokémon with the Festival Lead Ability attack twice while the Festival Grounds Stadium is in play. Other Pokémon ex include Palafin ex and a Tera Dragapult ex. The set has 133 cards: 101 numbered and 32 secret rares.
